annotation.title_clean: Does Artificial Intelligence threaten decent work?
annotation.title_en: Does Artificial Intelligence threaten decent work?
annotation.authors_or_issuer: International Labour Organization (ILO) – The Future of Work Podcast
annotation.venue: ILO Voices – The Future of Work Podcast
annotation.summary_en: Episode page of the ILO Future of Work podcast (July 2023) on whether generative AI such as ChatGPT threatens decent work. It frames the divided predictions on job loss versus task relief and asks how to ensure AI supports equity and social justice. It links to the ILO Regulating for Decent Work conference.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commentators are divided on whether generative AI will destroy jobs or relieve workers of mundane tasks.
Asks how AI can support poverty reduction, equity, decent work and social justice.
Links to the 8th Regulating for Decent Work Conference 2023 and an article on regulating AI at work.
